Paragraph: "The roar of the waters sounds like a distant battle drum, calling me to action even while my heart is weary..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Translating natural sound into a call to purpose despite severe mental fatigue.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama reframes the roar of the waterfall into a motivating battle call.
Outcome/Resolution: He begins shifting from passive grief toward purposeful resolve.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Utsaha (Awakening of inner enthusiasm and warrior spirit out of sorrow)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Nature calls the soul back to its divine purpose (Dharma), transforming passive grief into active resolve (Utsaha).
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Cognitive reframing: transforming ambiguous sensory cues into a psychological call to action, overcoming fatigue.
